name: subagents
label: 子代理任务
description: Register and inspect subagent tasks: op=create hands a goal to a subagent (optional tools whitelist); op=list shows the queue and statuses; op=get returns one task's result. The host orchestrator consumes and runs subagent tasks automatically.

goal.description: goal the subagent must achieve (for create)

input.description: extra input passed to the subagent (for create)

tools.description: tool whitelist the subagent may use (defaults to the default read-only tools)
